newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Billiton to list 1.66 bln shares on JSE.
newsitem.headline: Billiton to list 1.66 bln shares on JSE.

text.p: South African base metals group Billiton Plc, which was listed on the London Stock Exchange last week following its demerger from mining house Gencor Ltd, will take up a listing on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE) on Monday.
Billiton said in a published announcement that it would list 1.66 billion shares and 426.70 million renounceable letters of entitlement on the JSE.
It will be listed in the mining houses sector under the name "Billiton", it said.
Billiton last Tuesday gained instant blue chip status on the London stock market after successfully placing 375 million new shares at 220 pence -- well within the 210-240 range set earlier by Gencor.
The placing is part of the group's demerger Gencor, which will focus on its precious metals operations while Billiton seeks to expand beyond its home base.
No longer hampered by South African exchange controls, Billiton wants to expand existing operations while also eyeing privatisation projects in countries such as Venezuela, Colombia and Brazil.
